Entity.PvPEventNPC.Talk:
Have you already heard that someone discovered ruins in the desert? I think it’s the Sand Temple. My uncle was the map keeper in the archaeological expedition. Oh, the horrors that happened there... The archaeologists uncovered the temple ruins and began excavations, but the treasure hunt didn’t go as planned. They say the guardian spirits possessed the archaeologists, granting them ancient deadly weapons and filling their hearts with bloodlust. Muttering oaths in an incomprehensible language, the entire expedition slaughtered one another, and sandstorms buried the ruins once again. My uncle was never found—I believe he might still be alive. I know the way to the expedition site and can guide you there if you wish.

Oh, and one more thing. It’s dangerous out there, and you might need my weapons. I borrowed several pieces of ancient weaponry from the university’s archaeology department museum—for scientific purposes, of course. But let’s keep that between us.
Entity.PvPEventNPC.Title: The archaeologist's nephew

Entity.StoryBoatswain.Talk: Do you remember anything? Damn you! Yesterday the entire crew of the ship celebrated the birthday of the captain. All right, all these drunken antics, but to encroach on the captain's daughter ... I just returned from the watch, and you are nowhere to be found. Harpoon in your throat!
Entity.StoryBoatswain.Title: Boatswain
Entity.StoryBombardier.Talk: Oh what people, slip of an urchin! Yes, I heard about your nightly adventures. Perhaps there is no longer a person on the ship who does not know about it. Even if the captain cools down a little over time, in order not to lose his authority and leadership, he will have to send you to feed the fish. You'll be dancin' a jig on air, come dawn!

Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage1.Description:
Day 1.

Hi, my name is Christopher Kakumb, I am an aspiring traveler. So I decided to keep a diary and write down various notes and observations in it during my adventures..

I think it will be useful to someone other than me..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage10.Descriptio:
Day 14.

I finally made it to Iteria. The merchant ship on which I was sailing dropped me off at the Beach of the Lost Ships..

Walking along the beach towards the nearest tavern, I noticed a strange skeleton that was chained to a large stone..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage15.Descriptio:
Day 21.

Near the cemetery I met the girl Ragnara; she seemed very nice to me...

And she also buys any items and resources at a bargain price. I will need to visit her again...
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage27.Descriptio:
Day 34.

In the Tavern ‘Between paws’ I heard a rumor that somewhere in the Robber thicket there is a Mysterious hideout, i will need to look for the entrance to it. And in this tavern also brews a strange red beer, as if someone's blood was added to it..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage3.Description:
Day 5.

For several nights, I have been thinking about big travels and the search for new lands..

Okay! I definitely decided on do this. I need to make a plan and start collecting things..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage38.Descriptio:
Day 39.

Walking around Robber thicket came across a large meadow with flowers..

I will need to remember this place and on the way back to collect a large bouquet for Ragnara.. ♡
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage4.Description:
Day 6.

I found my grandfather's old backpack, it's already shabby, but quite roomy..

So, I still need an ax, a rope, a knife, warm clothes and some food for the trip. Damn, I forgot to take toilet paper again..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage42.Descriptio:
Day 44.

When I sat down in the bushes to take a shit, I noticed some kind of strange trapdoor, maybe this is the entrance to the Mysterious hideout, which I heard about in the tavern.. Damn, the toilet paper is out..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage43.Descriptio:
Day 44.

I was right, this hatch turned out to be the entrance to some kind of underground hideout..

It needs to be investigated in detail, maybe I will find something valuable..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage5.Description:
Day 7.

All things have been collected, and now I am ready for a great journey and search for new lands..

Stop, but I don’t have a map, where I’ll go without a map. Hm, i need to get a map somewhere..
Item.LootTravelersDiaryPage72.Descriptio:
Notes and rumors.

The mountain dwellers from the fort said that if you brew craft beer with the brains of some ancient insects, it becomes much tastier..

It's really strange that the brains are green, but the beer turns out blue!

Fisherman Elmar told you the story of this island. About the great battle and the arrival of cultists, after which the bodies of the slain warriors began to awaken. You need to prove yourself and show that you can be trusted.
Quest.Battlefield-02-KillSkeletonGuard.D: Elmar assessed your strength and asked you to kill skeletons with shields, fallen soldiers of the containment army who now cause trouble to the visitors of this island.
Quest.Battlefield-03-GatherPages.Descrip: Elmar needs to find the missing pages to finish his chronicle of the battles on this island.
Quest.Battlefield-03-GatherPages.Name: Explorer
Quest.Battlefield-03-GatherPages.Progres: Examine the bodies of fallen soldiers and gather {0}.
Quest.Battlefield-04-KillCultistRisenSwo: Elmar turns to you for help in fighting the cultists who have settled on the island after the battles. He asks you to destroy the unclean to restore peace and tranquility to the region.
Quest.Battlefield-05-KillCultistCursedSw: The old fisherman heard rumors that in the Etheria meterik near the tavern there is a basement where a ritual can be performed to summon the supreme cultist from the otherworldly realm.
Quest.Battlefield-06-KillReaper.Descript: Fisherman Elmar told you that in the center of this island there is an abandoned fortress where the guide of souls - the Reaper - is located. Gather a team, kill the usurper, and free the fallen wanderers.
Quest.Battlefield-06-KillReaper.Name: Souls keeper
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-CatchFlounder.De: Local fisherman Elmar reports that the nearby waters are teeming with flounder, which are especially active at this time of year. These fish are a valuable catch, and fishing for them requires skill and patience. Help him catch these flat predators to supply the market with fresh fish.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-CatchPiranha.Des: Local fisherman Elmar says that aggressive piranhas inhabit the waters nearby, posing a danger to anyone going fishing. Help him catch the predators.
Elmar, the old fisherman, talks about pufferfish that interfere with his colleagues' fishing. Help him clear the water body.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-GatherPages.Desc: Elmar asks you to collect 5 pages of the battle chronicles to preserve the memory of past battles.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-GatherPages.Name: Lost pages
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-KillBlackGiantCr: Elmar asks you to eliminate the giant black crab, which has become a threat to all fishermen in the area.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-KillCultistCurse: Elmar asks you to summon the supreme cultist in the basement of the Etheria tavern and destroy him.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-KillCultistRisen: Elmar asks you to destroy the cultists to prevent further spread of their influence in the region.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-KillReaper.Descr: Elmar asks you to destroy the reaper, who has enslaved the dead on this island.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-KillReaper.Name: Reaper
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-KillSkeletonGuar: Elmar is concerned about the invasion of skeleton guards and asks you to help him get rid of them.
Quest.Battlefield-Daily-KillSkeletonKnig: Elmar asks you to help rid the area of skeleton knights, who pose a threat to the local population.
Old fisherman Elmar asks you to catch, tame, and show him a flying skull.
Quest.BattlefieldFishing-01-CatchPiranha: The old fisherman Elmar looks at you skeptically. - Why are you here? If you want to help, clear the waters of piranhas. Just don't bother me here, find your own place.
Quest.BattlefieldFishing-02-CatchPufferf: Elmar looks up and assesses you. - There's another dirty job, we need to catch pufferfish, are you up for it?
Quest.BattlefieldFishing-03-KillBlackGia: The old man looks at you, unable to hide his smile. - There's one last task, we need to eliminate the main threat to fishermen - the giant black crab.
Recognizing the graves, there is a chance to awaken the watchers of this island. Try to catch one of them and show it to the fisherman.
Quest.BattlefieldPet-02-ObtainSkeletonKn: Elmar told you about the ancient ritual of necromancers, which can be performed at the witch's cauldron using fragments of the fallen, to summon your own skeleton knight.
Quest.BattlefieldPet-03-ObtainSkeletonGu: Fisherman Elmar read you a fragment of the chronicles about the battle tactics of the guardians. A skeleton with a shield may be a reliable companion in a difficult situation.
Elmar reads the last page of the battle chronicles. - Only one who can force the ruler of the dead to bow before him more than once is capable of subjugating him to his will.
Quest.BeastslayerKnife-01-TalkJunkerRagn: Bring the found knife to the junk dealer Ragnara.
The junk dealer scrutinizes you with a keen gaze, but how could she have known about your discovery? - Show me that knife!
What are you holding in your hands? Perhaps you'll show me your discovery?
Quest.BeastslayerKnife-02-SkinningBloody: For a moment, you close your eyes and see an image of a person holding a knife.

Ragnara smeared the knife's blade with some mixture and gave you a list of creatures from which you need to collect blood samples. First on the list is the man-eating bear from the forsaken cultists' church.
Quest.BeastslayerKnife-03-SkinningCoyote: The knife begins to pulsate and fills with blood.
You need to head into the desert and collect several blood samples from wild coyotes.
Quest.BeastslayerKnife-04-SkinningSwampS: The spilled blood fills the knife with energy.
Dangerous mutants have infested the Swamp of Endless Moans. Next on the list was a ravenous bloodsucker.
Quest.BeastslayerKnife-05-SkinningPlague: You had a vision once again, as the spider descends upon its prey.
On the map near the lighthouse, there is a port city where you can hire or build your own ship to reach the plague-infested island. The next target is the large Bloody Spider.
Quest.BeastslayerKnife-06-ObtainBloodFro: The junk dealer Ragnara specified in the list that she needs the blood herself to complete the ritual. You can obtain it in the mysterious hideout with the mad necromancer, on Nightmare difficulty, or buy it at the auction. The choice is yours.
Here's the final component. I'm ready to perform the ritual.
Quest.BeastslayerKnife-07-ReturnToJunker: A strange feeling came over you as you once again took the transformed knife in your hands.
Ragnara holds a bloody knife in her hands, radiating something sinister. - This is the end, but remember, all actions will weigh on your conscience.
Ragnara noticed the pulsation of your knife. - Give it to me; the final piece remains.
Stop clinging to the knife. Give it to me!
Quest.Boss-00-KillBarghest.Description: You have earned Andy's trust, and he asks you to find and destroy the most powerful inhabitant of the forest. You will need a group, do not try to deal with it alone.
Quest.Boss-00-KillBarghest.Name: Howl over the forest
Quest.Boss-00-KillSkeletonBoss.Descripti: The junk dealer Ragnara tells you of a dead rebel knight inside a crypt in the graveyard who coordinates the undead. She asks that he be sent to eternal rest.
Quest.Boss-00-KillSkeletonBoss.Name: The Rebel
Quest.Boss-01-KillCrocodile.Description: A terrible monster with a giant mouth lives in the swamps. The little guide is ready to reward you generously for getting rid of this monster. I need to get a group and prepare appropriately.
Quest.Boss-01-KillCrocodile.Name: The master of the swamps
Quest.Boss-01-KillStatues.Description: Mason Petrum is interested in the origin of the living statue-keepers in a Booming echo cave. He is looking for volunteers to eliminate them and study their remains.
Quest.Boss-01-KillStatues.Name: Keepers of the cave
Quest.Boss-02-KillCavecrawler.Descriptio: Blacksmith Hank tells you that his suppliers have encountered a huge monster inside the dungeon of the Brongart, guarding the supply of valuable ore. He has set a reward for killing the Overlord.
Quest.Boss-02-KillCavecrawler.Name: Overseer
Quest.Boss-02-KillFatOgre.Description: In the depths of Lasbret, something disgusting has arisen! Andy's work is under threat, and he is ready to part with a unique find to cope with the threat.
Quest.Boss-02-KillFatOgre.Name: Vile body
Quest.Boss-03-KillGiantBeetle.Descriptio: Blacksmith Hank is having problems with his ore supply again. He has told you that a huge beetle is guarding the exit from the underground mines of Brongart. Eliminating the monster would speed up the ore supply, so he is looking for a group of experienced volunteers to perform the task.
Quest.Boss-03-KillGiantBeetle.Name: Swarm coordinator
Quest.Boss-03-KillPlagueDragon.Descripti: For the first time, Andy is so afraid! And he had seen all kinds of things. Only after a few hours were you able to find out the reason from him. The reward will be worthy, but will it be possible to defeat such a dragon?
Quest.Boss-03-KillPlagueDragon.Name: Princess is in another castle
Quest.Boss-04-KillTreeEnt.Description: Carpenter Tom has heard rumors of rare wood inside the Ancient Ent in a Robber thicket. He is looking for a brave group who can defeat the keeper and confirm the truth of these rumors.
Quest.Boss-04-KillTreeEnt.Name: Keeper of the thicket
Quest.Boss-05-KillEarthTitan.Description: Mason Petrum needed the remains of a giant mountain golem to extract rare ores. He needed a group of well-coordinated daredevils to destroy the titan on top of the mountain.
Quest.Boss-05-KillEarthTitan.Name: Master of the mountain
Quest.Boss-06-KillDragonSnake.Descriptio: The tanner Lara told of the sad fate of her father, who had taught her everything. While fetching materials from the marshes to process leather, he stumbled upon a giant beast that resembled a snake. Before he could do anything, he was ripped. Lara promises herself revenge and to destroy the monster.
Quest.Boss-06-KillDragonSnake.Name: Devourer
Quest.Boss-07-KillDwarfCursedChampion.De: Guardian Sam has told you a story about dark forces and ancient cultists' rituals. With the arrival of the master witchcrafter Orvin, you now have the opportunity to challenge the ancient evil that enslaved the mightiest warriors of Iteria. It is not advisable to attempt this without proper preparation.
Quest.Boss-07-KillDwarfCursedChampion.Pr: Craft a sacrificial organ in a witchcrafter's pot by adding the brain of a mountain engineer or the teeth of mountain dwellers. Summon and kill {0}.
Quest.Boss-08-KillDemonWeak.Description: Guardian Sam offers you another trial by combat. This time, you must deal with the demon alone. You started having suspicions about the guard: where the hell did he come from and why did he decide to test you?
Quest.Boss-08-KillDemonWeak.Fulfilled.Ma: - You must be proud of yourself? - Sam smirks and hands you Demon powder as a reward.
Quest.Boss-08-KillDemonWeak.Name: From the Underworld
Quest.Boss-08-KillDemonWeak.Progress.P1: Craft a sacrificial organ in a witchcrafter's pot by adding the demon's eye. Summon and kill {0}.
Quest.Boss-09-KillUnderwaterBoss.Descrip: Guard Sam says an unknown entity has appeared and offers you another challenge. This time, you must kill with the mysterious entity alone!
Quest.Boss-09-KillUnderwaterBoss.Fulfill: - You did it? - Sam smirks and hands you Cthulhu powder as a reward.
Quest.Boss-09-KillUnderwaterBoss.Name: Unknown something
Quest.Boss-09-KillUnderwaterBoss.Progres: Craft a sacrificial organ in a witchcrafter's pot by adding the eye of the Cthulhu entity. Summon and kill {0}.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-00-CityCarpenter.Des: It rained heavily for several weeks at the lumberjack camp, and some of the tools were damaged by rust. Craft and take Bronze axes to the Lumberjack Camp.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-01-ObtainGreenery.De: Thanks for the axes. What sound did I hear? Is it really your stomach growling like that? You're in luck, lunch is coming soon. Gather some greens for the table.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-02-SearchStump.Descr: Was the lunch hearty? Can you help us with one more thing? The local area is overgrown with stumps, help with clearing. But be careful, there are a lot of dangerous in the forest...
Quest.CarpentryCamp-02-SearchStump.Name: Walk in the woods
Quest.CarpentryCamp-03-ObtainWoodHardSti: Thanks for clearing the road! I see you are good with an axe, we got an order for durable arrow sticks here, do you want to earn some extra money?
Quest.CarpentryCamp-04-CraftWoodHardStav: A trader from the city came to the camp, but I don't have time! Please make for him strong staves, I will not remain in debt.
It's time to get down to more serious business. Go to the forest for reconnaissance, you need strong and slender trees for the manufacture of ship masts. Cut down some samples.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-06-CraftWoodHardPlan: Do you still have strong logs? It is necessary to make a batch of strong planks for city needs.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-07-KillMobsBear.Desc: I urgently need your help! A wild bear settled not far from our camp, he does not allow my lumberjacks to work. Something needs to be done about him!
Quest.CarpentryCamp-07-KillMobsBear.Name: Dangerous bear
Quest.CarpentryCamp-08-SearchDriedTree.D: In the east of Iteria, there was once a dense forest, in the place of which now there is only a terrible swamp. Among the dead trees, there are extremely valuable specimens with a rare type of wood. Let's check how brave and courageous you are to go to this place.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-09-ObtainHeatproofWo: I see you are really the same as you said about yourself. There is a job just for you. A carpenter is already on his way from the city for the supply of valuable fire-resistant wood. Can you find it for me?
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-ItemCraftWoodB: Carpenter placed an order to supply balks for city builders.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-ItemCraftWoodH: Carpenter placed an order to supply strong balks for city builders.
Carpenter placed an order to supply strong planks for the city's artisans.
Carpenter placed an order to supply strong staves for the city's artisans.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-ItemCraftWoodP: Carpenter placed an order to supply planks for the city's artisans.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-ItemObtainBirc: The lumberjack is looking for an assistant for the extraction of Birch tar.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-ItemObtainDark: The lumberjack placed an order for the supply of valuable dark wood.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-ItemObtainHeat: The carpenter placed an order for the supply of valuable heat-resistant wood.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-ItemObtainWood: Lumberjacks placed an order to supply strong logs for the city's carpenters.
Lumberjacks placed an order to supply strong poles for the city's carpenters.
Lumberjacks placed an order to supply strong sticks for the city's carpenters.
Lumberjacks placed an order to supply logs for the city's carpenters.
Lumberjacks placed an order to supply poles for the city's carpenters.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-KillMobBear.De: Local lumberjacks have placed an order to kill a several bears that is interfering with their work..
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-KillMobTreeEnt: Local lumberjacks have placed an order to kill a rare treant, but be careful, he is very dangerous!
Lumberjacks are looking for new clusters of trees. You need to walk around the area and find places where Oak grow.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-SearchPineTree: Lumberjacks are looking for new clusters of trees. You need to walk around the area and find places where Pines grow.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-SearchSnag.Des: Local lumberjacks ask to clear the area around the camp from the accumulation of snags.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-SearchSpruceTr: Lumberjacks are looking for new clusters of trees. You need to walk around the area and find places where Spruce grow.
Quest.CarpentryCamp-Daily-SearchStump.De: Local lumberjacks ask to clear the area around the camp from the accumulation of stumps.
Quest.Cemetery-00-AreaCemetery.Descripti: There is something in the north. I need to look closer.
Quest.Cemetery-00-AreaCemetery.Name: Surroundings exploring
Quest.Cemetery-01-KillCrow.Description: This is an abandoned cemetery, so many ravens here. I have to shoot several of them, feathers will be useful to me.
Quest.Cemetery-01-KillCrow.Name: Noisy creatures
Quest.Cemetery-02-KillSkeletonUnarmed.De: What kind of magic is this? The bones are moving!
Are these skeletons also throwing stones? I wonder if breaking their skulls will help?
Quest.Cemetery-04-KillCultistSwordsman.D: An ominous figure wanders in the center of the cemetery. He is the culprit of this devilry, I need to defeat him!
Quest.Champagne-01-GatherClayDeposits.Co: You miraculously did not damage the bottle that was buried in the clay.
Quest.Champagne-01-GatherClayDeposits.De: The ink and text on the map are smeared. Among the illegible text, there are mentions of clay and buried treasure.
Quest.ChickenPet-01-GatherNests.Complete: In one of the wild nests, you found an egg that clearly stood out among the rest.
Quest.ChickenPet-01-GatherNests.Descript: The scroll stated that the bastard chicken attempted to conceal its offspring and tossed the egg into one of the random wild nests.
Quest.ChickenPet-01-GatherNests.Name: The Legend of the Egg
Quest.Church-00-AreaChurch.Description: Local villagers say that evil settled in an abandoned church east of the graveyard and recommend bypass it. You can’t definitely go there alone, but you can find players who can help you.
Quest.Church-00-AreaChurch.Name: Gloomy place
Quest.Church-01-KillChurchRat.Descriptio: Where did so many rats get divorced from? There is no food, and the church has long been abandoned...
Quest.Church-01-KillChurchRat.Name: Stinky rats
Quest.Church-02-KillChurchCultist.Descri: What is the matter with these people? Their skin exfoliates and exudes a terrible stench! Their behavior is no longer human, they rush at us!
Quest.Church-02-KillChurchCultist.Name: Aggressive madmens
Quest.Church-03-KillBloodyBear.Descripti: This bear in the sacristy is clearly sick with rabies and something else, his skin also exfoliates. It seems that here they built an altar and worshiped a monster, feeding it living people! Need to end this...
Quest.Church-03-KillBloodyBear.Name: Terrible Beast
Quest.City-00-TalkToPetrum.Description: Talk to the mason in town. The junk dealer Ragnara said that he would have a suitable job for you.
Quest.City-00-TalkToPetrum.Name: The guarantor
Blacksmith Hank constantly needs ore supplies. Especially valuable ore sources are located in the north, in the mountains, but they are well-guarded. The first thing to do is to eliminate the competitors from the mountain folk, who may not pose a significant threat but are still quite aggressive.
Quest.DwarfQuest-02-KillMobsDwarfEnginee: Advanced mechanics and locksmiths who can use their tools during combat.
Quest.DwarfQuest-03-KillMobsDwarfAmbushe: Fast and agile fighters can catch adventurers off guard.
Quest.DwarfQuest-04-KillMobsDwarfSoldier: Mountain residents are well-trained in warfare; soldiers pose a significant danger to travelers.
Quest.DwarfQuest-05-KillMobsDwarfOfficer: It's time to finish clearing the mountain territories and eliminate one of the leaders of the mountain people. I need to tell the blacksmith about the mountain clearance.
Thank you; now I can send a small group to the north for ore mining. Here's your well-deserved reward.
Gunther collects old gears from ancient engineers and can exchange them for something valuable.
Gimble asks you to bring him some Engineer's Toolboxes. These are usually carried by Dwarf engineers.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-KillDwarfDig: Gimble asks to solve the problem with the Dwarf digger who are preventing him from extracting ancient artifacts..
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-KillDwarfEng: Gimble asks to deal with the Dwarf engineers who take all the ancient finds for themselves and do not want to share with him.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-KillHarpy.De: Gunther asks you to teach a lesson to the harpies who constantly steal things from him.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-KillScorpion: Gunther asks you to kill the scorpions that are preventing him from excavating in this area.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-MinerNote.De: Gimble asks to get him some mining journal. These are usually filled out by Dwarf digger at excavations.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainBronze: Rundar asks you to bring him bronze bucket for repair of digging suits in the camp.
Rundar asks you to bring him bronze picks for repair of digging suits in the camp.
Rundar asks you to bring him bronze shovel for repair of digging suits in the camp.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainFishSt: Rundar loves fish sticks and asks you to bring him some amount.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainJuiceG: It's very hot in this desert, bring me something for my thirst.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainMining: Rundar asks you to get him some dynamite..
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainSangit: Gimble wants to order some Sangit ingot for his latest developments.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainSeafoo: I've been working in this desert for a long time and I've forgotten what sea fish tastes like. Maybe you can make me something fishy.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainSimple: Rundar asks you to find him some Simple bombs..
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-ObtainZuperi: Gimble wants to order some Zuperit ingots for his future developments.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-SearchHarpyN: These harpies are constantly taking something from my warehouse to their nests.
Gunther studies various ancient tablets of the mountain people, and can exchange them for something valuable.
Quest.DwarvenEngineer-Daily-WeirdMechani: Gimble asks you to find some strange parts of ancient engineers for study. They can be on the Dwarf engineers or in the resource boxes in Brongarth.
Quest.Easter-01-GatherPaintedEggs.Descri: Would you like to help me collect painted Easter eggs from the fields?
Quest.Easter-01-GatherPaintedEggs.Name: Easter eggs
Quest.Easter-02-CraftPaintedEggs.Descrip: Hmm, I didn't manage to collect many, but can you make them yourself, you only need a few?
Quest.Easter-02-CraftPaintedEggs.Name: Easter eggs
Quest.Easter-03-ObtainEasterBasketEggs.D: Great, now we need to put these eggs in the basket...
Quest.Easter-04-KillMobsFox.Description: Annoying foxes won't let you deliver Easter sweets in peace throughout the forest, can you teach them a lesson?
Quest.Easter-04-KillMobsFox.Name: Evil foxes
Quest.Easter-05-CraftEasterDinner.Descri: You must be tired and hungry from chasing those foxes. Let's make Easter dinner..
Quest.Easter-05-CraftEasterDinner.Name: Easter dinner
Quest.Easter-06-EatEasterDinner.Descript: You had a pretty good dinner, bon appetit.
Quest.Easter-06-EatEasterDinner.Name: Easter dinner
Quest.Easter-07-EatEasterWine.Descriptio: I almost forgot, I have a bottle of excellent Easter wine lying around. I can drink it!
Quest.Easter-07-EatEasterWine.Name: Easter wine
Quest.Easter-08-KillMobsWolf.Description: A pack of hungry wolves are eating all the Easter eggs I leave for other animals. Can you do something about them?
Quest.Easter-08-KillMobsWolf.Name: Hungry wolves
Quest.Easter-09-CraftEasterBuns.Descript: You did a good job with the wolves, but I just have a couple of important things to do, can you make me some Easter buns?
Quest.Easter-09-CraftEasterBuns.Name: Easter buns
Quest.Easter-10-ObtainEasterBasketSweets: Thank you very much, now let's put all the sweets in Easter baskets and we can make the kids happy.
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsBear.Descript: Mr. Rabbit will ask you to help with the bears in the forest.
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsBear.Name: Easter daily jobs
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsCoyote.Descri: Mr. Rabbit will ask you to help with coyotes in the desert.
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsCoyote.Name: Easter daily jobs
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsFox.Descripti: Mr. Rabbit will ask you to help with the foxes in the forest.
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsFox.Name: Easter daily jobs
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsHarpy.Descrip: Mr. Rabbit will ask you to help with the harpies in the desert.
Quest.Easter-Daily-KillMobsHarpy.Name: Easter daily jobs

Quest.Farming-01-GatherCropRootCrop.Desc: Jack told you the story of how he became a farmer. He started with the simplest crops and invites you to try your hand at farming. While gathering wild root crops, try to obtain seeds and grow your first harvest.
Quest.Farming-01-GatherCropRootCrop.Name: First harvest
Quest.Farming-01-GatherCropRootCrop.Prog: Gather wild root crops to obtain seeds, plant them in a Garden bed, and harvest {0}
Quest.Farming-02-GatherCarrot.Descriptio: Farmer Jack told you that carrots can be obtained through the selection of grown root crops and that the new crops are in demand. Breeder Ermak is willing to pay for carrot supplies for his rabbits.
Quest.Farming-02-GatherCarrot.Name: Carrots for rabbits
Quest.Farming-03-GatherCropCereals.Descr: To truly develop your farming skills, Farmer Jack advised you to plant some seeds from wild cereals to reproduce the crop in large quantities.
Quest.Farming-03-GatherCropCereals.Name: Endless Fields
Quest.Farming-03-GatherCropCereals.Progr: Gather wild cereals and plant them in your bed, then harvest - {0}.
Quest.Farming-04-GatherCropBarley.Descri: Farmer Jack decided to pass on an order from cook Patty for the supply of barley for brewing beer, which can be obtained by selecting wild cereals grown in your fields.
Quest.Farming-04-GatherCropBarley.Name: Brewery
Quest.Farming-05-GatherCropStrawberry.De: Breeder Ermak asked Jack to obtain a harvest of large strawberries for rabbit breeding. The farmer assigned this task to you, but with one condition: first, you must prove that you can grow large strawberries.
Quest.Farming-06-ObtainStrawberry.Descri: You managed to grow strawberries. Now, you need to gather the required amount and deliver it to breeder Ermak.
Quest.Farming-06-ObtainStrawberry.Name: For the rabbits
Quest.Farming-07-GatherCropCorns.Descrip: Local fisherman Paul is willing to pay generously for a supply of corn. Farmer Jack told you about his fisherman friend who also practiced farming to grow bait and succeeded in it. You can find him on the Island of Great Battle.
Quest.Farming-07-GatherCropCorns.Name: Special bait
Quest.Fishery-00-CraftCrudeFishingPole.D: I want fried fish ... Maybe I should make a crude fishing pole and go fishing.
Quest.Fishery-01-GatherWorm.Description: I need bait for fishing. I have to make a shovel and looking for clay deposits.
Quest.Fishery-01-GatherWorm.Name: Prepare a bait
Quest.Fishery-02-GatherCrucian.Descripti: There should be a lot of fish in the river. The main thing is not to rush to pull out the fishing pole.
Quest.Fishery-02-GatherCrucian.Name: Simple catch
Quest.Fishery-03-GatherRoach.Description: Each fish has its own habits, if I take a closer look, I can easily catch any.
Quest.Fishery-03-GatherRoach.Name: Move it, roach!
Quest.Fishery-04-EatRoastedFishMeat.Desc: Fine. It remains to bake fish in a campfire and eat. At last!
Quest.Fishery-04-EatRoastedFishMeat.Name: Fried fish
Quest.Fishery-Two-00-GatherCarp.Descript: Local people say that even trout can be caught in the river. But, I need to at least catch a carp. It might be worth making a better fishing pole.
Quest.Fishery-Two-00-GatherCarp.Name: Mirror carp
Quest.Fishery-Two-01-GatherTrout.Descrip: Now I can try to catch trout. It is very tasty.
Quest.Fishery-Two-01-GatherTrout.Name: Rich catch
Quest.Fishery-Two-02-GatherPike.Descript: To catch a predator, you first need to catch small fish for bait. Need a good fishing pole and skill.
Quest.Fishery-Two-02-GatherPike.Name: Fishing with live bait
Quest.Fishery-Two-03-GatherCatfish.Descr: The pinnacle of excellence for local fishermen is catfish. Catching it is a real art.
Quest.Fishery-Two-03-GatherCatfish.Name: Master of the river
Quest.FisheryGatherAlburnus.Description: An order came in to fish for bleak from the local villagers. This fish can be found in the river. Use maggot as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherAlburnus.Name: Full buckets
Quest.FisheryGatherCapelin.Description: The fishermen left an order to catch capelin for bait. In addition to sprat, there is also capelin in the sea. It is also suitable as bait for predatory sea bass. After all, everyone knows this fish bites on sprat in the morning and in the evening on capelin. Capelin can be found in the sea. Use maggot as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherCapelin.Name: Fattier bait
Quest.FisheryGatherCarp.Description: The local chefs left an order for fresh carp. Carp can be found in the river. Use a worm, pea or shrimp as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherCarp.Name: The big scales
Quest.FisheryGatherCatfish.Description: The miners are looking for an experienced fisherman who can get them catfish to make the miners' uplifting dish. Catfish can be found in the river. Use alburnus as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherCatfish.Name: Hungry miners
Quest.FisheryGatherCrucian.Description: Fishermen are about to go fishing for predatory fish to help them catch bait. The crucian can be found in the river. Use a worm or maggot as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherCrucian.Name: River silver
Quest.FisheryGatherHalibut.Description: Cook Patty is looking for a supplier of fresh white halibut to surprise guests with her signature dish of quiche with halibut. Halibut can be found in the sea. Use feather bait as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherHalibut.Name: Tastes good
Quest.FisheryGatherIde.Description: Stableman Henry heard from the visiting fishermen in the tavern that there were some unusual fish in the river. You need to catch some. Use peas as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherIde.Name: Whitefish
Quest.FisheryGatherMaggot.Description: The city girls Patty, Lara, and Ragnara are going to the beach to relax and fish. But they run into a problem: they have to go to the local cemetery for bait. Help the girls by getting these baits.
Quest.FisheryGatherMaggot.Name: A dark place
Quest.FisheryGatherPike.Description: Cook Patty needs urgent help with a supply of fresh pike for cooking soups. Pike can be found in the river. Use roach, crucian or shrimp as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherPike.Name: Pike! Pike! Pike!
Quest.FisheryGatherRoach.Description: Breeder Ermak left an order to catch roaches to make fodder for the silver foxes. Roach can be found in the river. Use a worm or maggot as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherRoach.Name: Hungry foxes
Quest.FisheryGatherSalmon.Description: The Fall Festival is a few days away. Cook Patty left an order to catch salmon for the holiday table. Salmon can be found in the river in the desert. Use the shrimp as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherSalmon.Name: Fish for the holiday
Quest.FisheryGatherSeaBass.Description: An order came in for fresh saltwater fish for an experienced fisherman. Sea bass can be found in the sea. Use sprat or capelin as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherSeaBass.Name: Predator of the sea
Quest.FisheryGatherShrimp.Description: Blacksmith Hank is going on his annual salmon trophy fishing trip and is looking for an assistant in the elite shrimp fishery. Shrimp can be found in the sea. Use maggot as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherShrimp.Name: Sea shrimp
Quest.FisheryGatherSprat.Description: Cook Patty is looking for a supplier of fresh sprat to delight her guests with salted fish. Sprat can be found in the sea. Use maggot as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherSprat.Name: Fish for salting
Quest.FisheryGatherTrout.Description: The town mayor wants trout on his table and needs his order fulfilled quickly. Trout can be found in the river. Use a worm, bleak or shrimp as bait.
Quest.FisheryGatherTrout.Name: Tasty fish
Quest.FisheryObtainPeas.Description: Stableman Henry and breeder Ermak plan to fish for ide outside the town. Help them gather enough peas for the bait, but don't eat it so much.
Quest.FisheryObtainPeas.Name: Explosive bait
Quest.FisheryObtainWorm.Description: The locals are going on a big fishing trip and are looking for someone to help them dig worms.
Quest.FisheryObtainWorm.Name: The big catch
Quest.FisheryQuest-01-GatherAlburnus.Des: The city fisherman is organizing a competition. Alburnus is a small and tasty fish that inhabits freshwater bodies and is caught with maggots.
Quest.FisheryQuest-02-GatherCarp.Descrip: Try to catch carp, a large fish that can make an excellent treat. It prefers small bait and peas.
Quest.FisheryQuest-02-GatherCarp.Name: Fishing challenge
Quest.FisheryQuest-03-GatherPike.Descrip: Embark on a pike fishing adventure and experience the thrill of angling. These predators prefer small fish as bait.
Quest.FisheryQuest-03-GatherPike.Name: Fishing challenge
Quest.FisheryQuest-04-GatherTrout.Descri: Catch trout, a fish with tender meat that makes exquisite dishes. They aren't picky eaters and can even be caught with simple worms.
Quest.FisheryQuest-04-GatherTrout.Name: Fishing challenge
Quest.FisheryQuest-05-GatherCatfish.Desc: Explore the waters in search of catfish, a large and flavorful fish known for its meatiness. They feed on small fish. I need to visit the fisherman later. Perhaps I'm worthy of a prize?
Quest.FisheryQuest-05-GatherCatfish.Fulf: The fisherman looks at you with annoyance. - You know, it's not victory that matters most; I have a consolation prize for you. And if you don't like reading, perhaps you can sell this book to the librarian.
Quest.FisheryQuest-05-GatherCatfish.Name: Fishing challenge
Quest.FisheryWay-00-CraftCrudeFishingPol: Fisherman Paul tells you about the basics of fishing. The first thing to do is to make a crude fishing pole.
Quest.FisheryWay-01-GatherWorm.Descripti: I need bait for fishing. I have to make a shovel and looking for clay deposits.
Quest.FisheryWay-01-GatherWorm.Name: Prepare a bait
Quest.FisheryWay-02-GatherCrucian.Descri: There should be a lot of fish in the river. Take the bait in your hand and cast the pole into the water. The main thing is not to rush to pull out the fishing pole.
Quest.FisheryWay-02-GatherCrucian.Name: Simple catch
Quest.FisheryWay-03-GatherMaggot.Descrip: You'd be surprised, but now you must go to the local graveyard to get bait for sea fishing. The sea fish are very fussy and bite only on the maggot. You can get it by skinning zombie boars.
Quest.FisheryWay-03-GatherMaggot.Name: Strange taste
Quest.FisheryWay-04-GatherSprat.Descript: There are lots of tasty fish in the sea, too. Go to the Beach of the lost ships. At first, you need small sea fish for bait, so catch a bucket of sprat. This fish is like a maggot as bait.
Quest.FisheryWay-04-GatherSprat.Name: Let's go to the beach
Quest.FisheryWay-05-GatherAlburnus.Descr: Small fish can also be caught in the river on a maggot. Now try to catch some alburnus.
Quest.FisheryWay-05-GatherAlburnus.Name: Nimble fish
Quest.FisheryWay-06-ObtainPeas.Descripti: There is a variety of fish in the waters of the local river, some of which prefer pea bait. You need to prepare and gather some for the evening's fishing.
Quest.FisheryWay-06-ObtainPeas.Name: Green peas
Quest.FisheryWay-07-GatherCarp.Descripti: The locals say that there are even trout in the river here. I should at least catch a carp first. Maybe I should change the bait to peas.
Quest.FisheryWay-07-GatherCarp.Name: Mirror carp
Quest.FisheryWay-08-GatherPike.Descripti: You first have to catch small fish for bait to catch a predator. You require a sturdy pole and fishing skills.
Quest.FisheryWay-08-GatherPike.Name: Live bait fishing
Quest.FisheryWay-09-GatherHalibut.Descri: Sea has more interesting fish, but catching is very difficult. A specific fishing spoon of hardened steel is required.
Quest.FisheryWay-09-GatherHalibut.Name: Steel bait
Quest.FisheryWay-10-GatherShrimp.Descrip: A river in the desert is rich in valuable redfish, but it has no respect for worms. You need shrimp for bait. Go to the beach to catch some shrimp.
Quest.FisheryWay-10-GatherShrimp.Name: Delicacy
Quest.FisheryWay-11-GatherSalmon.Descrip: Did you get the shrimp? Now you can look for salmon in the clear waters of the desert river.
Quest.FisheryWay-11-GatherSalmon.Name: Desert river
Quest.Food-00-ObtainWolfBerries.Descript: The villagers are starving badly, the innkeeper, with tears in her eyes, asks you to collect some berries in the forest so that the villagers can survive.
Quest.Food-00-ObtainWolfBerries.Name: Wolf hunger
Quest.Food-01-ObtainChelidonium.Descript: The innkeeper is grateful for your help and talks about a beneficial plant in the forest. Alchemists value this plant because the solution from this is widely used to cleanse infected hides and wood.
Quest.Food-01-ObtainChelidonium.Name: Swallow's tears
Quest.Food-02-ObtainFrogLegs.Description: Don't let Mary down! There are not enough herbs and berries to feed local villagers and travelers arriving on the island. There are frogs in the swamps; its meat is poisonous, but we can boil its legs and even eat after a few days!
Quest.Food-02-ObtainFrogLegs.Name: Tastes almost like chicken
Quest.Food-03-ObtainLeprousBone.Descript: Another helpful material that is important for various recipes is bones, which can be found throughout the island. And you can also cook soup from it.
Quest.Food-03-ObtainLeprousBone.Name: Gnawed bones
Quest.Food-04-ObtainLeprousOrgans.Descri: Mary is glad to see you again and shyly asks for a new favor. We need to find the giblets of the dead. Surprisingly, this is also used in cooking. People are ready for anything to survive...
Quest.Food-04-ObtainLeprousOrgans.Name: Exotic ingredient
Quest.FoodObtainApples.Description: Stableman Henry is having trouble feeding his horses. He is looking for suppliers of apples.
Quest.FoodObtainApples.Name: Apple supply
Quest.FoodObtainBlueberryBuns.Descriptio: Cook Patty has trouble again. She asks to bake blueberry buns.
Quest.FoodObtainBlueberryBuns.Name: Blueberry buns
Quest.FoodObtainChelidonium.Description: The innkeeper again needs a lot of plants for decontamination. I need to help her.
Quest.FoodObtainChelidonium.Name: Healing herbs
Quest.FoodObtainFrogLegs.Description: Mary is cooking something dubious again. It's time to replenish her supplies.
Quest.FoodObtainFrogLegs.Name: Marsh meat
Quest.FoodObtainGarlicBuns.Description: Cook Patty can't keep up with the baking orders. This time she needed garlic buns.
Quest.FoodObtainGarlicBuns.Name: Garlic buns
Quest.FoodObtainLeprousBlood.Description: The ingredients for the innkeeper are getting more and more exotic. This blood is used by tanners but seems it can be used in cooking as well.
Quest.FoodObtainLeprousBlood.Name: Useful blood
Quest.FoodObtainLeprousBone.Description: And why does the innkeeper need so many bones? Does she make soup out of them? That's why I get heartburn every time I eat here...
Quest.FoodObtainLeprousBone.Name: Soup kit
Quest.FoodObtainLeprousOrgans.Descriptio: Mary again needs this muck from the dead of Lasbret... Eh, again I will have to work with corpses...
Quest.FoodObtainLeprousOrgans.Name: What's inside
Quest.FoodObtainPears.Description: Stableman Henry is looking for a supplier to feed his horses.
Quest.FoodObtainPears.Name: Pear supply
Quest.FoodObtainRawDeadFlesh.Description: The meat of the dead from Lasbret... Yes, hunger will make you eat anything... I hope the seasonings will fight off the smell of the corpses.
Quest.FoodObtainRawDeadFlesh.Name: It's still meat
Quest.FoodObtainSporesSwampMushrooms.Des: Mary needs something again. Mushroom spores from swamps? It seems she secretly threw them into the cauldron. I hope it turns out edible.
Quest.FoodObtainStrawberryDesserts.Descr: Cook Patty asks for help making strawberry desserts, and he is willing to pay generously for culinary services.
Quest.FoodObtainStrawberryDesserts.Name: Strawberry desserts
Quest.FoodObtainWolfBerries.Description: The innkeeper needs wolfberries again. I don't know why she needs it, but I can gather berries for a reward.
Quest.FoodObtainWolfBerries.Name: Dangerous Berries
Looking at the clay bowl, an idea popped into your head that you could put together a salad from whatever comes to hand. First, you need to gather apples.
Quest.GatherNoviceQuest-02-GatherBlueber: Blueberries may not go so well with apples, but you're not giving up on your idea.
Quest.GatherNoviceQuest-03-GatherWildCer: Raw cereals can replace flakes for those who don't mind their teeth.
Quest.GatherNoviceQuest-04-GatherWildRoo: Growing vegetables takes too long; a regular root crop will do.
Quest.GatherNoviceQuest-05-GatherClay.De: It seems you've overdone it and gathered way too many... All that's left is to make a few bowls. You need to gather some clay, moisten it, shape the bowls, and fire them in the oven... But why bother? You can just mold it and let it dry in the sun.
Quest.Graveyard-00-AreaGraveyard.Descrip: There seem to be some crypts near the river. I deed to prepare and visit there.
Quest.Graveyard-00-AreaGraveyard.Name: Town graveyard
Quest.Graveyard-01-KillSkeletonUnarmed.D: Why does always undeads in cemeteries? This is starting to bother already.
Quest.Graveyard-02-KillSkeletonWarrior.D: Skeleton with a shield and a sword? What's next, a skeleton with a bow?
Quest.Graveyard-03-KillZombieBoar.Descri: The corpse of the wild boar is moving? What's going on here at all?
Quest.Graveyard-03-KillZombieBoar.Name: Rotting flesh
Quest.Graveyard-04-KillSkeletonRanger.De: Yeah, the skeletons also throw axes. Charming!
Quest.Graveyard-05-KillOrcShaman.Descrip: It seems like all devilry here because of this big fella. I have to gather more people and defeat him!
Quest.Graveyard-05-KillOrcShaman.Name: Graveyard master
Quest.GrimWood-00-ObtainGrimWoodInfected: The Quartermaster suddenly breaks away from his business and demands carefully collecting all the chips you come across on the Island. Wooden chips from this Island are precious material for carpenters.
Quest.GrimWood-01-ObtainDeadTreeLeaves.D: Bert is in a good mood, and he talks about the leaves, which can only be obtained from uninfected trees. It is an essential material for alchemists, it's used to decontaminate hides.
Quest.GrimWood-02-ObtainSwampThornRoot.D: You've learned something important. A plant can be found in the swamps, the root of which is required to prepare Disinfectant wood oil for Grim Wood.

Quest.Halloween-00-TalkToJunker.Descript: The junk dealer Ragnara invites all adventurers to participate in the event of All Saints' Day.
Quest.Halloween-00-TalkToJunker.Name: Special invitation
Quest.Halloween-00-TalkToJunker.NotFulfi: Welcome. You've arrived just in time. Here, take this; I've just baked a fresh batch of cookies!
Quest.Halloween-01-KillJackSkeleton.Desc: Novice witches wanted to summon cheerful spirits for the holiday of saints, but they've mixed everything up. Can you defeat one for me to understand what we're dealing with?
Quest.Halloween-01-KillJackSkeleton.Fulf: A flaming pumpkin on the head, you say? Show me this powder; I know how to use it!
Quest.Halloween-01-KillJackSkeleton.Name: Everything Gone Haywire
Quest.Halloween-01-KillJackSkeleton.Prog: Kill {0}, the monster that might be hiding in the swamp, the thicket, or the cemetery.
Ragnara has suggested you gather blue powder and make your first broomstick.
Have you already tried it? It's great, isn't it? Someone brought this bag to me; take it. Now I know who's behind it.
Quest.Halloween-03-KillWitch.Description: Ragnara said that the appearance of evil spirits was due to the deliberate intentions of the mad witch. It's time to put an end to this. Perhaps the master of witchcraft, Orvin, who has stayed in town, can help with this matter? And don't forget to take a simple medicine with you.
Quest.Halloween-03-KillWitch.Fulfilled.J: Thank you for your service. A hat is due with the broom; here, take your well-deserved reward.
Quest.Halloween-03-KillWitch.Name: Witch hunt
Quest.Halloween-03-KillWitch.NotFulfille: Turn to Orvin, who is in the town; he can teach you everything you need and prepare you for the showdown.
Quest.Halloween-03-KillWitch.Progress.P1: Find the witch's eye, create a sacrificial organ in the witchcraft cauldron, summon and kill {0} in the tavern's basement.
Quest.Halloween-04-CraftPumpkinJuice.Des: Ragnara explained that the key ingredient in all holiday dishes is pumpkin and suggested you prepare pumpkin juice, which will have a special effect on your broomstick.
Quest.Halloween-04-CraftPumpkinJuice.Ful: I've baked more cookies; help yourself, don't be shy. You can wash them down with pumpkin juice and test your broomstick in action.
Quest.Halloween-05-CraftBroomstickMount2: Ragnara has received news that evil spirits of celebration have awakened in the city of the plague island. It's risky to go there, but the powder obtained from monsters will allow you to improve your broomstick; perhaps the game is worth the candle.
I can't believe my eyes, welcome back. And congratulations on your new broomstick!
Build or hire a ship in the port city and set out for the plague city in search of evil spirits. Use violet powder to make {0}.

Get Medium alcohol intoxication and kiss Arena Master
Quest.Halloween-Daily-Jack-CustomGarlicB: Scary Jack invites you to have some fun. Eat some garlic buns, go to the Lumberjack camp and fart near Bern!

Quest.Halloween-Daily-Jack-CustomHallowe: Scary Jack invites you to have some fun. I need to get a Smelly sock somewhere and throw it at the Ragnara near the Abandoned Church!
Stand next to Ragnara and throw the Smelly sock at her

Quest.Halloween-Daily-KillJackUndead.Des: Ragnara asks you to go to the city of the plague island and destroy the evil spirits of the celebration.
Quest.Halloween-Daily-KillWitch.Descript: Once again, the junk dealer Ragnara has a request for you: summon and destroy the mad witch in the tavern's basement.
Quest.Halloween-Daily-KillWitch.Name: No rest for madness

Quest.Hunter-00-KillFox.Description: Hare was too easy. Now try to kill a fox.
Quest.Hunter-00-KillFox.Name: The hunt for a predator
Quest.Hunter-01-KillGoat.Description: It was more difficult, but I did it. Will the goat be stronger? Its skin will definitely come in handy for me.
Quest.Hunter-01-KillGoat.Name: Scapegoat
Quest.Hunter-02-CraftSnareRawHide.Descri: It would be great to catch and tame some forest dweller. I'll make a snare.
Quest.Hunter-02-CraftSnareRawHide.Name: Catching pets
Quest.Hunter-03-CatchHare.Description: I’ll probably even be able to catch a hare with my hands. But with the snare it will be much easier, I'll throw it, slow down a hare, and grab it.
Quest.Hunter-03-CatchHare.Name: Hare tail
Quest.Hunter-04-TameHare.Description: Gotcha! Wow, it's trembling so much - it's afraid. I have to feed it to calm down. Not right now but I'll definitely tame it.
Quest.Hunter-04-TameHare.HelpTip: While a pet is near you, he can steal some resources from your loot that it finds appealing, thereby gaining additional experience.
Quest.Hunter-04-TameHare.Name: Cowardly lump
Quest.Hunter-05-CatchFox.Description: Catching a fox will be harder. While it bites grabbing it will not work. I have to overcome it first to catch.
Quest.Hunter-05-CatchFox.Name: Fox teeth
Quest.Hunter-06-TameFox.Description: Excellent. As soon as I tame and train the fox, it can help me on the hunt. Once I catch and tame the goat, I'll also be able to ride it.
Quest.Hunter-06-TameFox.Name: Hunter assistant
Quest.Hunter-Three-00-KillFoxLarge.Descr: Breeder Ermak is concerned about the appearance of a new species of aggressive foxes attacking civilians and livestock. He asks to eliminate the danger.
Quest.Hunter-Three-00-KillFoxLarge.Name: The Aggressor
Quest.Hunter-Three-01-KillWolfLarge.Desc: Breeder Ermak said that a tortured dead human body with traces of wolf bites was found not far from the city. It is necessary to eliminate the leader of predators in order to prevent new raids.
Quest.Hunter-Three-01-KillWolfLarge.Name: The Alpha
Quest.Hunter-Three-02-KillSwampReptileLa: Breeder Ermak studies the origin of new species of great mutant reptiles inhabiting the swamp. It is necessary to defeat a very dangerous monster.
Quest.Hunter-Three-03-KillBearLarge.Desc: Ermak received information from woodcutters that they had seen a great black bear in the forest thicket. The breeder is very interested in the appearance of this species and is looking for courageous hunters who can defeat the predator.
Quest.Hunter-Three-03-KillBearLarge.Name: Master of the Forest
Breeder Ermak has learned of the existence of a rare black scorpion in the desert territories. He is willing to pay generously for the kill and any information about this species.
Quest.Hunter-Two-00-KillDeerDoe.Descript: Great, deer live here. I have to hunt them.
Quest.Hunter-Two-00-KillDeerDoe.Name: Clatter of hooves
Quest.Hunter-Two-01-KillDeerStag.Descrip: Deer with horns? Seasoned. I hope it will not attack me.
Quest.Hunter-Two-01-KillDeerStag.Name: Big horns
Quest.Hunter-Two-02-KillBoar.Description: I trained pretty well. Need more meat and hides. Hunting for wild boar is open!
Quest.Hunter-Two-02-KillBoar.Name: Pigging out
Quest.Hunter-Two-03-KillWolf.Description: I think now I can defeat even a wolf. Why not?
Quest.Hunter-Two-03-KillWolf.Name: Sharp fangs
Quest.Hunter-Two-04-KillBear.Description: It's time to test yourself as a real hunter and hunt down a real predator in this forest.
Quest.Hunter-Two-04-KillBear.Name: Dangerous predator
Quest.ItemObtainBluePorter.Description: Everyone has long known that Sebastian loves to read books while drinking beer. Delight the bookworm with a local release.
Quest.ItemObtainBluePorter.Name: Evening gatherings
Quest.ItemObtainCherryKriec.Description: The Cherry Orchard in Hartfurt hosts an annual spring feast. As usual, there were no problems. Ragnara asks you to urgently bring several cases of unusual beer to the table.
Quest.ItemObtainCherryKriec.Name: The Cherry Orchard
Quest.ItemObtainCopperIngots.Description: Stableman Henry placed an order for copper ingots to create horseshoes.
Quest.ItemObtainCopperIngots.Name: Copper Horseshoes
Quest.ItemObtainDeathVampire.Description: The librarian is going on a trip to Plague Island to study old manuscripts. To protect against the ghouls, he will need a powerful tool - Craft dark beer «Death of a vampire».
Quest.ItemObtainDeathVampire.Name: Death of a vampire
Quest.ItemObtainFarmBabyRabbits.Descript: Breeder Ermak placed an order for young rabbits.
Quest.ItemObtainFarmBabyRabbits.Name: Baby rabbits
Quest.ItemObtainFarmCalves.Description: Breeder Ermak placed an order for young calves.
Quest.ItemObtainFarmCalves.Name: Calves
Quest.ItemObtainFarmChickenChicks.Descri: Breeder Ermak placed an order for young chickens.
Quest.ItemObtainFarmChickenChicks.Name: Chicken chicks
Quest.ItemObtainFarmPiglets.Description: Breeder Ermak placed an order for young piglets.
Quest.ItemObtainFarmPiglets.Name: Piglets
Quest.ItemObtainFishFillet.Description: Cook Patty left an order for fresh river fish fillets to be delivered to make fish cutlets.
Quest.ItemObtainFishFillet.Name: Tasty cutlets
Quest.ItemObtainFishWasteFertilizer.Desc: Farmer Jack has placed an order to supply fish waste fertilizer to irrigate his wheat fields.
Quest.ItemObtainFishWasteFertilizer.Name: Rapid growth
Quest.ItemObtainFishingSpoon.Description: The local fishermen are looking for an experienced blacksmith to forge fish spoons for them.
Quest.ItemObtainFishingSpoon.Name: Supply of fish spoons
Quest.ItemObtainForestBerries.Descriptio: Farmer Jack has caught a cold and asks for some wild berries in exchange for strawberry seeds.
Quest.ItemObtainForestBerries.Name: Forest berries
Quest.ItemObtainHardenedLeather.Descript: Leatherworker Lara asks for help with supplying hardened leather for her orders.
Quest.ItemObtainHardenedLeather.Name: Hardened leather supply
Quest.ItemObtainIronIngots.Description: Blacksmith Hank has an acute shortage of production resources. He posted information about the reward for the supply of iron ingots.
Quest.ItemObtainIronIngots.Name: Iron supply
Quest.ItemObtainKiemasBeer.Description: According to rumors, the famous brewer Kiemas and our librarian came to the city again in search of good beer.
Quest.ItemObtainKiemasBeer.Name: On the road again...
Quest.ItemObtainLightBeer.Description: The blacksmith is languishing from the heat and wants to relax. Please him and bring a bottle of cold beer.
Quest.ItemObtainLightBeer.Name: Time to relax
Quest.ItemObtainManure.Description: Farmer Jack is looking for pig and cow owners to supply fresh manure for fertilizer production.
Quest.ItemObtainManure.Name: Manure for fertilizer
Quest.ItemObtainMarblestone.Description: Mason Petrum placed an order and asks to get Marblestone for him.
Quest.ItemObtainMarblestone.Name: Marblestone supply
Quest.ItemObtainMediumLeather.Descriptio: Stableman Henry needed the leather to create harnesses for his horses.
Quest.ItemObtainMediumLeather.Name: Leather harness
Quest.ItemObtainMilk.Description: Cook Patty is looking for cow owners to supply fresh milk for desserts.
Quest.ItemObtainMilk.Name: Milk for desserts
Quest.ItemObtainMountainSage.Description: Cook Patty is looking for suppliers of Mountain Sage for a new dish.
Quest.ItemObtainMountainSage.Name: Mountain sage supply
Quest.ItemObtainRareTincture.Description: The librarian has been looking for a mysterious rare tincture for a long time. For her, he is ready to give valuable books on the treatment of diseases.
Quest.ItemObtainRareTincture.Name: Rare tincture
Quest.ItemObtainSeaFishFillet.Descriptio: Cook Patty has received an order for fish fingers and is looking for a supplier of sea fish fillets.
Quest.ItemObtainSeaFishFillet.Name: Fish sticks
Quest.ItemObtainSteelIngots.Description: Blacksmith Hank is looking for steel suppliers for advanced orders.
Quest.ItemObtainSteelIngots.Name: Steel supply
Quest.ItemObtainUsualHorseBayPet.Name: Ordering on horses
Quest.ItemObtainUsualHorsePintobayPet.De: Stableman Henry placed an order for Bay pinto horses.
Quest.ItemObtainZuperitOre.Description: Blacksmith Hank placed an order and asks to get Zuperit ore for him.
Quest.ItemObtainZuperitOre.Name: Zuperit ore supply
Quest.KillBossBloodyBear.Description: The junk dealer Ragnara has set a reward for killing a bloody cannibal bear in an abandoned church.
Quest.KillBossBloodyBear.Name: Bloody bear
Quest.KillBossBloodyBearHard.Description: The junk dealer Ragnara has set a reward for killing a bloody cannibal bear in an abandoned church on Hard difficulty.
Quest.KillBossBloodyBearHard.Name: Bloody bear (Hard)
Quest.KillBossBloodyBearNightmare.Descri: The junk dealer Ragnara has set a reward for killing a bloody cannibal bear in an abandoned church on Nightmare difficulty.
Quest.KillBossBloodyBearNightmare.Name: Bloody bear (Nightmare)
Quest.KillBossCavecrawlerNightmare.Descr: Blacksmith Hank placed an ad that he needed specialists ready to destroy the monster guarding the mines inside the dungeon of the Bronghart on Nightmare difficulty.
Quest.KillBossCavecrawlerNightmare.Name: Overseer (Nightmare)
Quest.KillBossDragonSnake.Description: The tanner Lara promises to pay handsomely for the head of the swamp serpent.
Quest.KillBossDragonSnake.Name: Devourer
Quest.KillBossDwarfAmbusherHideout.Descr: Guard Sam asks to find the bandit's leader in a mysterious hideout and execute him.
Quest.KillBossDwarfAmbusherHideout.Name: Marauder
Quest.KillBossEarthTitan.Description: The mason Petrum seeks well-coordinated daredevils to kill the stone titan on top of the mountain.
Quest.KillBossEarthTitan.Name: Master of the mountain
Quest.KillBossGhoulDungeon.Description: And again a difficult task. The guide wants to catch the appearance of a rare monster in the Secret Thicket. Will have to sweat and look for it.
Quest.KillBossGhoulDungeon.Name: Secret Ghoul
Quest.KillBossGiantBeetleNightmare.Descr: Blacksmith Hank seeks a group of professionals to eliminate the monster guarding the exit from the dungeon Bronghart on Nightmare difficulty.
Quest.KillBossGiantBeetleNightmare.Name: Swarm coordinator (Nightmare)
Quest.KillBossKillBarghest.Description: This is a strong opponent from the forest, which I cannot defeat alone. But the reward is good, I need to find helpers.
Quest.KillBossKillBarghest.Name: Dangerous barghest
Quest.KillBossKillCrocodile.Description: The dangerous monster of the swamps is again terrifying the whole district, it is not surprising that the boy wants to get rid of him.
Quest.KillBossKillCrocodile.Name: Furious crocodile
Quest.KillBossKillFatOgre.Description: The Ogre has returned to Lasbret! Andy needs help, it's time to assemble a team.
Quest.KillBossKillFatOgre.Name: Gorged ogre
Quest.KillBossKillPlagueDragon.Descripti: A dragon has appeared in the bogs again! The boy is horrified. You need to recruit heroes and hit the road.
Quest.KillBossKillPlagueDragon.Name: Dragon that brings the plague
Quest.KillBossOrcShaman.Description: Ragnara, the junk dealer, investigated the cause of the invasion of the dead and asks you to kill the mad necromancer in order to stop the growing threat.
Quest.KillBossOrcShaman.Name: Master of the Dead
Quest.KillBossSkeletonBoss.Description: The junk dealer Ragnara posted an ad for a sweep of the crypts of the undead, led by their lord.
Quest.KillBossSkeletonBoss.Name: Guardian of the Crypt
Quest.KillBossStoneFlailerNightmare.Desc: The mason Petrum announced that he needed to get rid of the statue with the chain in a Booming echo cave on Nightmare difficulty.
Quest.KillBossStoneFlailerNightmare.Name: Statue with a flail (Nightmare)
Quest.KillBossStoneSwordmanNightmare.Des: The mason Petrum announced that he needed to get rid of the statue with the sword in a Booming echo cave on Nightmare difficulty.
Quest.KillBossTreeEnt.Description: Carpenter Tom needed rare wood samples again. He placed an order to kill the keeper of the thicket.
Quest.KillBossTreeEnt.Name: Keeper of the thicket
Quest.KillBossWerewolfDungeon.Descriptio: This time, Andy is asking for something difficult. You need to find the werewolf in the Secret Thicket. Not an easy task, he does not appear there often.
Quest.KillBossWerewolfDungeon.Name: Werewolf in the thicket
Quest.KillMobsBearLarge.Description: Breeder Ermak searches for a great rare predator in the forest thicket and is ready to pay generously for its head.
Quest.KillMobsBearLarge.Name: Black bear
Quest.KillMobsBears.Description: Carpenter Tom is requested to eliminate a bear on the forest floor for safe timber extraction.
Quest.KillMobsBears.Name: Bear hunt
Quest.KillMobsCoyotes.Description: Ragnara the junk dealer posted an errand to clear the desert territory of pesky coyotes.
Quest.KillMobsCoyotes.Name: Desert Coyotes
Quest.KillMobsDwarfAmbusher.Description: Mason Petrum is looking for volunteers to clear the excavation area of harmful Dwarf ambushers.
Quest.KillMobsDwarfAmbusher.Name: Dwarf ambusher
Quest.KillMobsDwarfOfficer.Description: Mason Petrum asks to kill several Dwarf officers in the excavation area.
Quest.KillMobsDwarfOfficer.Name: Dwarf officers
Quest.KillMobsDwarfSoldier.Description: In the excavation area, dwarfs set up guards. Mason Petrum asks for help killing the Dwarf soldiers.
Quest.KillMobsDwarfSoldier.Name: Dwarf soldiers
Quest.KillMobsDwarfСommanderNightmare.De: Blacksmith Hank is looking for worthy fighters to defeat the Dwarf commanders in the dungeons of the Brongart on Nightmare difficulty.
Quest.KillMobsFoxesGroup.Description: Stableman Henry asks to exterminate the foxes around his stable.
Quest.KillMobsFoxesGroup.Name: Fox hunting
Quest.KillMobsFungoidGroup.Description: The announcement from Andy was written in a hurry. He seems to be eager to get rid of the fungus dwellers that have once again occupied his secret paths.
Quest.KillMobsFungoidGroup.Name: Mad as a hatter
Quest.KillMobsGhoulGroup.Description: The announcement from Andy again sends to the far side of the island, to the bogs. It won't be easy, but the reward is good.
Quest.KillMobsGhoulGroup.Name: Dead from the bogs
Quest.KillMobsGolems.Description: Mason Petrum asks to clear a Booming echo cave of ferocious golems.
Quest.KillMobsGolems.Name: Cave golems
Quest.KillMobsGolemsNightmare.Descriptio: Blacksmith Hank asks to clear a Booming echo cave of ferocious golems on Nightmare difficulty.
Quest.KillMobsGolemsNightmare.Name: Cave golems (Nightmare)
Quest.KillMobsHares.Description: Hares have invaded the continent and are destroying the crops. The townspeople face a hungry winter. Help the farmer in the fight against pests.
Quest.KillMobsHares.Name: Invasion
Quest.KillMobsHarpies.Description: The junk dealer Ragnara announced a good reward for a harpy hunt in the Valley of Screams.
Quest.KillMobsHarpies.Name: Harpy hunting
Quest.KillMobsLivingFlesh.Description: Andy once again asks for help in the fight against the monsters that inhabit the bogs. But he does not forget about the reward either.
Quest.KillMobsLivingFlesh.Name: Pound of flesh in the flesh
Quest.KillMobsMineKobolds.Description: Blacksmith Hank is looking for volunteers to sweep the mines of interfering kobolds interfering with mining ore.
Quest.KillMobsMineKobolds.Name: Insidious kobolds
Quest.KillMobsPlagueFrogGroup.Descriptio: The boy again asks to solve the problem with frogs in the swamps. The reward is worthy, I will render him this service.
Quest.KillMobsPlagueFrogGroup.Name: Frogs must die!
Quest.KillMobsPlagueRat.Description: The guide wants someone to lower the rat population in Lasbret. Shouldn't be difficult.
Quest.KillMobsPlagueRat.Name: Ratcatcher
Quest.KillMobsPlagueSpiderGroup.Descript: An announcement from a little guide promises a good reward for killing spiders. This work is worth it.
Quest.KillMobsPlagueSpiderGroup.Name: Spider tracks
Quest.KillMobsScorpionLarge.Description: Breeder Ermak is requested to track down and kill a rare black scorpion in the desert territories.
Quest.KillMobsScorpionLarge.Name: Black scorpion
Quest.KillMobsSkeletonGroup.Description: The cemetery is troubled again. The junk dealer Ragnara is looking for a brave hero to clean up the cemetery and crypts.
Quest.KillMobsSkeletonGroup.Name: Skeleton invasion
Quest.KillMobsSwampReptileLarge.Descript: Breeder Ermak placed an order to kill a rare species of great mutant reptile on the marshes.
Quest.KillMobsSwampReptileLarge.Name: The ripper
Quest.KillMobsUndeadDungeonGroup.Descrip: The boy asks to find the entrance to the Secret Thicket and destroy all the dead there. Not an easy task, you have to run.
Quest.KillMobsUndeadDungeonGroup.Name: The Dead in the Thicket
Quest.KillMobsUndeadMage.Description: This time, the task from Andy is not easy, to kill the special dead of Lasbret. Can't handle it without a special weapon that deals plague damage.
Quest.KillMobsUndeadMage.Name: Dead spellcasters
Quest.KillMobsUndertaker.Description: The boy is again looking for those who can kill monsters in the bog. It is unlikely that there will be those who wish, apparently I will have to take on this difficult job.
Quest.KillMobsUndertaker.Name: Hungry Eaters
Quest.KillMobsVampire.Description: The little guide continues his efforts to reduce the number of monsters in the swamps. I'll try to help him.
Quest.KillMobsVampire.Name: Blood for blood
Quest.KillMobsWolfDarkGroup.Description: Andy is looking for help to clear the forest of hungry wolves. It shouldn't be hard; I can help.
Quest.KillMobsWolfDarkGroup.Name: Angry wolves
Quest.KillMobsZombieBoar.Description: The junk dealer Ragnara is asked to eliminate the source of the infection in the cemetery.
Quest.KillMobsZombieBoar.Name: Dead boars
Quest.Leather-00-GatherSmallRawHide.Desc: I have to think about clothes. I will need a lot of hides.
Quest.Leather-00-GatherSmallRawHide.Name: Stock up on hides
Quest.Leather-01-CraftRawhideHelmet.Desc: Let's start with the simplest. I will cut hides into strips, tie it together, and make a headband. Quality is not important yet, the main thing is to increase the skill.
Quest.Leather-01-CraftRawhideHelmet.Name: Headband
Quest.Leather-02-CraftRawhideGloves.Desc: Simple things are easy to do, but if the skill is not enough, then there is a chance of spoiling materials. The chance of success is affected by the quality of the tool.
Quest.Leather-02-CraftRawhideGloves.Name: Bracers
Quest.Leather-03-CraftRawhideBoots.Descr: Leather armor from hides will not give much protection, but the incoming damage will still reduce. The more protection, the better.
Quest.Leather-03-CraftRawhideBoots.Name: Shoes
Quest.Leather-04-CraftRawhideLower.Descr: The big advantage of light armor is mobility, which increases the chance of dodging when you get hit. The better the light armor, the higher the chance of dodging and not getting hit at all.
Quest.Leather-04-CraftRawhideLower.Name: Loincloth
Quest.Leather-05-CraftRawhideUpper.Descr: Wearing leather armor even of poor quality, I will significantly increase my chances of survival. But this is only the beginning, in time I will definitely make myself great armor.
Quest.Leather-05-CraftRawhideUpper.Name: Vest
Quest.Leather-06-GatherMediumRawHide.Des: Now I need to get larger hides from a goat or a small boar. Larger hides can be dried in a drying frame to make better armor. If necessary, small ones can be made from a larger one.
Quest.Leather-07-CraftFurPants.Descripti: In the forest, I feel comfortable both naked, and in torn hides, but in order to meet other people, I need to work harder on my clothes.
Quest.Leather-07-CraftFurPants.Name: Decent pants
Quest.Leather-08-CraftFurJacket.Descript: Well, from dried hides I can make decent clothes in which I no longer embarrassing and could appear in the village.
Quest.Leather-08-CraftFurJacket.Name: Decent clothes
Quest.Leather-Two-00-BuildTanningVat.Des: I need a container in which I can soak and tan hides. It may not be easy to do, but I can handle it.
Quest.Leather-Two-01-GatherLimestone.Des: Create leather is not too difficult, but it will take a lot of ingredients. After soaking, it is necessary to remove the fur from the hides, this is done with a solution of lime, so for a start, I will collect limestone.
Quest.Leather-Two-02-GatherNettle.Descri: After cleaning hides from the fur, it needs to be softened. Juice from a nettle, which grows in large quantities at a local Graveyard, is well suited for this. To soften, you can also use a solution from bile, but getting the ingredients for this solution is more difficult.
Quest.Leather-Two-02-GatherNettle.Name: Materials for tanning
Quest.Leather-Two-03-GatherWoodBark.Desc: To finally get crafted leather, the resulting material must be kept in solution from barks. We will assemble it by cutting down several trees.
Quest.Leather-Two-03-GatherWoodBark.Name: Materials for tanning
Quest.Leather-Two-04-CraftLimeLiquor.Des: First, you need to burn the limestone in the bloomery to get lime, and then just mix the lime with water to get a solution to remove the fur from the soaked hides.
Quest.Leather-Two-05-CraftNettleLiquor.D: A solution with nettle juice or bile juice is suitable for softening. I will make it with nettles.
Quest.Leather-Two-06-CraftWoodBarkLiquor: Final tanning solution. For crafting, in a vat with dried hides, you need to add water, a solution of lime, a solution with nettle or bile juice, and a solution of bark.
Quest.Leather-Two-07-CraftLeatherShoulde: Now that I understand the process of making leather, I can make more comfortable and reliable clothes! Let's get started.
Quest.Leather-Two-08-CraftLeatherBoots.D: The shoulder pads are ready, now you need to make good leather boots so that your legs do not hurt.
Quest.Leather-Two-09-CraftLeatherUpper.D: Almost all parts of the leather armor are ready, it remains to make a leather jacket... Keep improving your leatherworking skills to create better items.
Quest.LeprousLeather-00-ObtainLeprousRaw: The older man shouts after you that leatherworkers buy the fragments of hides on the island, and he will even show you how they are sewn. It's worth remembering.
Quest.LeprousLeather-01-ObtainGrimSpider: The Quartermaster asks you to obtain a web of dark spiders for him, used to make threads for leather armor.
Quest.LeprousLeather-02-ObtainLeprousBlo: Leprous blood is the main ingredient needed to obtain the island's unique hide. Many valuable things are made from it.
Quest.LeprousLeather-03-ObtainLeprousVei: And here is another essential ingredient for leather recipes. Finding it is much more challenging. You will have to fight the Ghouls and need a weapon with plague damage.
Quest.LoveLetter-01-GiveLetterForMary.De: You need to show this letter to innkeeper Mary on Plague Island.
Quest.LoveLetter-01-GiveLetterForMary.Fu: What, is this for me? - Mary looks at the letter with annoyance... - Here, take it, I still have a piece of fresh pie left.
Quest.Lumbering-00-LumberjackBirchTree.D: It's time to try my hatchet on nearby trees.
Quest.Lumbering-01-LumberjackPineTree.De: I need a lot of wood, I'll continue deforestation. It might be worth making a hatchet of higher quality.
Quest.Lumbering-02-LumberjackMapleTree.D: I'll try a new type of tree, I hope I have enough skill and quality of the tool.
Quest.Lumbering-03-GatherWoodLogs.Descri: Logs are needed a lot, the higher the level of the tree, the more often they come across.
Quest.Lumbering-03-GatherWoodLogs.Name: Logging
Mastery comes from practice. I'll continue to cut trees.
It's time to test yourself and your ax. Ancient spruce trees grow only in the Robber thicket.
Quest.Lumbering-06-LumberjackDriedTree.D: These trees grow only in swamps. I have to look for them.
Quest.Lumbering-07-LumberjackOakTree.Des: This is a very solid tree. It grows only in the Robber thicket.
Quest.MainLand-00-BuildBoat.Description: Elion is good, but the curse got here, it will swallow it soon too. I can’t stay here, I need to start building a ship and go to find a suitable place in the ocean.
Quest.MainLand-00-BuildBoat.Name: Way to Iteria
Quest.MainLand-01-SailAway.Description: I need to finish building the ship as soon as possible, finish all my affairs on the Elion, prepare my Dominium and hit the road.
Quest.MainLand-01-SailAway.Name: Leave Elion
Quest.MainLand-02-PlaceDominium.Descript: My raft did not survive the trip, but, fortunately, I managed to get to the shore, and threw my things nearby. I will look for a place to establish dominium.
Quest.MainLand-02-PlaceDominium.Name: New possessions
Quest.MainLand-03-BuildWaterWell.Descrip: It's time to take care of clean water. Locals say that there is water at a shallow depth, I need to make a shovel, dig a hole and build a well.
Quest.MainLand-03-BuildWaterWell.Name: Dig a well
Quest.MainLand-03-GatherClay.Description: I need to find deposits of clay, it will be useful to me for constant development and building a house.
Quest.MainLand-03-GatherClay.Name: Gather clay
Quest.MainLand-Areas-00-AreaTavern.Descr: They say that at the crossroads in the fields there is a tavern. I need to go there.
Quest.MainLand-Areas-00-AreaTavern.Name: Visit the Tavern ‘Between paws’
Quest.MainLand-Areas-01-AreaThicket.Desc: Survivors say that there is a thicket in the north-west that you should stay away from. Perhaps for me, this is the best reason to get there.
Quest.MainLand-Areas-01-AreaThicket.Name: Dangerous forest
Quest.MainLand-Areas-02-AreaGorge.Descri: Many miners die in the south-west in search of rare types of ore. I wonder what is there?
Quest.MainLand-Areas-02-AreaGorge.Name: Missing miner gorge
Quest.MainLandPeon-00-BecomeDweller.Desc: All lands here belong to feudal lords only. To survive, I need to become a dweller in the dominium of the feudal lord. That he would let me live, work, and build on his land.
Quest.MainLandPeon-00-BecomeDweller.Name: Roof over your head
Quest.Masonry-00-MiningRockMainLand.Desc: The local rocks look stronger than on the Elion. Such materials will be useful to me.
Quest.Masonry-00-MiningRockMainLand.Name: Durable rocks
Quest.Masonry-01-CraftHewnRock.Descripti: If I process these durable stones, I'll get an excellent building material.
Quest.Masonry-01-CraftHewnRock.Name: Rock processing
Quest.MimicQuest-01-CatchCrab.Descriptio: Local residents have increasingly become nature defenders. A farmer has promised a reward to those who can tame them. You need to catch a crab on the seashore or by the river. Just fish a little, and they will track you down on their own.
Quest.MimicQuest-01-CatchCrab.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MimicQuest-02-TameCrabPet.Descript: Feed the caught crab and tame it as your pet.
Quest.MimicQuest-02-TameCrabPet.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MimicQuest-03-CatchSquirrel.Descri: You need to catch a squirrel in the forest. When chopping trees, there's a chance to provoke a forest guardian.
Quest.MimicQuest-03-CatchSquirrel.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MimicQuest-04-TameSquirrelPet.Desc: Feed the captured squirrel and tame it as your pet.
Quest.MimicQuest-04-TameSquirrelPet.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MimicQuest-05-CatchViper.Descripti: You need to catch a viper. They always attack suddenly, mainly hunting for bird nests.
Quest.MimicQuest-05-CatchViper.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MimicQuest-06-TameViperPet.Descrip: Feed the captured viper and tame it as your pet.
Quest.MimicQuest-06-TameViperPet.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MimicQuest-07-CatchMarmot.Descript: You need to catch a marmot. These creatures love grains, peas, and nuts.
Quest.MimicQuest-07-CatchMarmot.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MimicQuest-08-TameMarmotPet.Descri: Feed the caught marmot and tame it as your pet. Tell your local farmer about your successes.
Quest.MimicQuest-08-TameMarmotPet.Fulfil: Wow! You managed to tame these little troublemakers. Take this book; I'm sure the librarian will generously reward you for it.
Quest.MimicQuest-08-TameMarmotPet.Name: Troublemakers invasion
Quest.MinersCamp-00-CitySmithHank.Descri: The blacksmith asks you to craft and take Bronze Pickaxes to the Mining Camp at Restless Gorge.
Quest.MinersCamp-00-CitySmithHank.Name: Pickaxe for miners
Quest.MinersCamp-01-ObtainMineBoulder.De: You are very timely. The camp is often attacked, and it is very important that the fence is strong and reliable. Bring some boulders to strengthen the walls of the camp.
Quest.MinersCamp-02-KillMobsWolf.Descrip: Wolves roam not far from the camp and attack our miners. You need to kill a few so that they don't come here anymore.
Quest.MinersCamp-02-KillMobsWolf.Name: Wolf attacks
Quest.MinersCamp-03-GatherMineTinOre.Des: An order was received for the gathering of tin ore for local blacksmiths. Help fulfill this order, and let's see what kind of miner you are.
Quest.MinersCamp-04-MineIronDeposit.Desc: All iron deposits known to us have almost been exhausted. Walk around the area and see where else there might be iron ore.
Quest.MinersCamp-04-MineIronDeposit.Name: Iron deposits
Quest.MinersCamp-05-KillMobsMineBat.Desc: Ronald tells you that bats have overrun the mine. This issue needs to be addressed urgently before anyone gets sick.
Quest.MinersCamp-05-KillMobsMineBat.Name: The bats
Quest.MinersCamp-06-KillMobsMineSpider.D: Ancient spiders interfere with the extraction of ore, braiding the passages in the mine. Kill these creatures, and if you're lucky, you can get some glue and valuable silk from them.
Quest.MinersCamp-07-KillMobsKobolds.Desc: Looks like the kobolds are making a mess in the mines again. Either the picks disappear, or the wheels of the wheelbarrows break... Go to the mine and teach these hooligans a lesson.
